scenarios.name: Export customization settings covering multiple interface areas

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the current customization has no staged changes
the user exports the current settings to a new XML file
the XML file parses as a customization settings document
it contains ribbon state, custom panel, and quick access toolbar settings
it contains marking menu and mini-toolbar settings
